title: Add secrets-scan (Gitleaks) as hard gate step
description: Add a Gitleaks secrets-scan step as the second step in .woodpecker.yml, immediately after init. Must fail the pipeline with exit code 1 on any secret detection.

tasks.title: Add secrets-scan step to .woodpecker.yml
tasks.description: Insert a new step named 'secrets-scan' at index 1 (after 'init') using image zricethezav/gitleaks:v8.18.2. Command: gitleaks detect --source=. --report-format=json --report-path=artifacts/security/gitleaks.json --exit-code=1. Add a comment referencing .gitleaks.toml and .secrets.baseline above the step.
acceptance: Step named 'secrets-scan' exists at index 1 (zero-based) in steps list

tasks.title: Create test_woodpecker_yml.py to validate pipeline structure
tasks.description: Create tests/unit/test_woodpecker_yml.py with tests that parse .woodpecker.yml via pyyaml and assert: valid YAML, step index 1 is 'secrets-scan', step names in order (init, secrets-scan, lint-yaml, ...), image pinning, and required commands.
acceptance: Test asserts 'secrets-scan' is at index 1 (zero-based) in steps list
Test asserts init is at index 0
Test asserts secrets-scan uses correct image

tasks.title: Update docs/plan.md to mark WP-003 acceptance as test-covered
tasks.description: Update docs/plan.md to check off the acceptance criteria boxes for WP-003 and note that automated tests exist.

tasks.title: Run full validation suite
tasks.description: Run pytest tests/, make validate, yamllint .woodpecker.yml, and pre-commit run --all-files to ensure no regressions.
acceptance: pytest tests/ passes with zero failures
